\begin{example} \end{example}[Strict hyperbolicity of the $p$-system] ↗ ex:p-system-definition ↗ def:strictly-hyperbolic-system 1. ch11:11.1-ex-4\group Conservation Laws

For the $p$-system (6), we have \[ \mathbf{u}_t + \mathbf{B}(\mathbf{u})\mathbf{u}_x = 0, \] for \[ \mathbf{B}(z) = DF(z) = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & -1 \\ -p’(z_1) & 0 \end{pmatrix}. \] The eigenvalues are $\lambda _1=-\sigma $, $\lambda _2=\sigma $, for $\sigma :=p'(z_1)^{1/2}$. These are real and distinct provided we hereafter suppose the strict hyperbolicity condition \[ (41) \qquad p'>0. \] For (8), condition (41) says that the stress $p(u_x)$ is strictly increasing in the strain $u_x$. \end{example}
